name: 10X Affiliation motion
source: Values read from the 10X Affiliation site code (GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes) and the 10X Trader coin code.
afterEffectsHowTo: For each curve: on the first keyframe set outgoing influence and outgoing speed = speedFactor x (change / duration); on the last keyframe set incoming influence and speed = speedFactor x (change / duration). speedFactor 0 means speed 0. Easing plugins (Flow, Ease Copy, Motion Tools) take the cubicBezier values directly.

ease-out-strong.use: Every entrance, hover and state change. The site CSS curve. Default for type and UI moves.

ease-reveal.use: Close cubic match for GSAP expo.out, which drives every scroll reveal and the hero on the site. Use for big rises and image settles.

ease-in-out-strong.use: Things that move while on screen: camera moves, morphs, a panel sliding across.

ease-soft-out.use: GSAP power2.out. Video and image fade-ins (the hero video).

smoothstep.use: The coin intro turn (3p^2 - 2p^3, exact as a bezier).

linear.use: Loops only: coin turn, marquee bands, slow drifts.

durations.name: panel
durations.use: Accordion and step changes (220ms crossfade, 16px slide, 3px blur).

durations.name: counter-roll
durations.use: Slide counter: new number rises from 100% below with a fade. ease-out-strong.

durations.name: card
durations.use: Card in a grid: rise 22px, 90ms apart.

durations.name: reveal
durations.use: Default block reveal: rise 24px and fade, 80ms apart.

durations.name: hero
durations.use: Headline characters, 40ms apart. Also the final call to action (rise 40px).

durations.name: line-two
durations.use: Second headline line: rise 28px, blur 10px to sharp.

durations.name: count
durations.use: Count-up numerals (spring, no overshoot, settles by about 2.2s).

durations.name: hero-video
durations.use: Background video: fade in, scale 1.06 to 1, ease-soft-out.

durations.name: shine
durations.use: One shine pass across the accent line; then 4s rest.

durations.name: coin-turn
durations.use: One full coin turn in loops (the site idles at 14s a turn).

moves.name: Hero sequence
moves.source: Site hero timeline (GSAP). Times are when each part starts.

steps.detail: 2.8s per pass, 4s between passes, 110deg band 40% wide, navy to sky

moves.name: Rise and settle
moves.note: Scale y by 1080/site width when you need more travel on a 1080 canvas: 24px on the site reads as about 40px on a post.

moves.name: Image settle
moves.note: Imagery inside a mask: the mask holds, the picture settles.

moves.name: Shine sweep
moves.note: On the accent line or a big number only. Never on body text.

moves.name: Count-up
moves.note: Overdamped: no overshoot. Exact curve: 1 - (r2*e^(r1*t) - r1*e^(r2*t)) / (r2 - r1), r1 = -1.435, r2 = -43.565 (t in seconds). Reaches 95% at about 2.1s.

moves.name: Bar grow
moves.note: Value labels land a beat after their bar.

steps.what: Buying power total fades from 15% to 100% opacity

moves.name: Exit
moves.rule: Leave faster than you came: 60% of the entry time, same curve family, 50% of the travel.

rules: 30 fps for social, 60 fps for showreels and the site.
Everything eases. Linear only for loops (coin turn, ticker bands).
Nothing bounces, shakes, glitches or whip-pans. No spring overshoot.
Hold every message at least 1.5s after it lands; read time is about 0.3s a word on top.
Type enters with the hero sequence or rise and settle; imagery settles from scale 1.14.
One hero motion per frame: the coin, a number or the headline, not all three at once.
Under reduced motion or for stills, show the end frame.
